plugins.description: Drive your real, logged-in Chromium browser (Chromium, Chrome, Brave, Edge) from Claude Code over CDP. Bundles Playwright MCP and chrome-devtools-mcp against one running browser, with skills for reading pages as accessibility trees, recovering from clicks Playwright refuses, and working canvas apps.
